rules.prepare:
# As in Debian: gettext's autopoint would replace m4 files of gnulib with # older ones. cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" AUTOPOINT=true autoreconf -vfi
# As in Debian, which uses the regex code of gnulib on musl. if [ "$AELTRA_LIBC_NAME" = "musl" ]; then USE_INCLUDED_REGEX="--with-included-regex" else USE_INCLUDED_REGEX="--without-included-regex" fi
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -O3" export LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS -Wl,-z,defs"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-silent-rules \ --disable-nls \ $USE_INCLUDED_REGEX
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
cat > "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/rgrep" << 'EOF' #!/bin/sh
exec grep -r "$@" EOF chmod 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/rgrep"
for NAME in egrep fgrep rgrep; do ln -s grep.1 \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/man/man1/$NAME.1" done
